text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a non-review research study focused on developing and applying a novel coupled model (LPJ-FLUS) for national-scale land use and land cover change (LUCC) prediction in China. It explicitly simulates future LUCC from 2015 to 2100 under two SSP-RCP scenarios (SSP1-RCP2.6 and SSP5-RCP8.5), satisfying the requirement of ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison. The study implements spatial modeling at 1-km resolution across the entire country of China, producing mapped LULC projections. It reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Figure of Merit, FoM) based on historical validation against MODIS data for 2010 and 2015, demonstrating spatially explicit predictive performance. The primary objective is LUCC simulation, particularly improving natural vegetation dynamics by integrating mechanistic and statistical approaches. All core inclusion criteria are met, and none of the exclusion criteria apply.)
